standard.rule_description: Gas water heaters shall be modeled using natural gas as their fuel. Exceptions: Where natural gas is not available for the proposed building site, as determined by the rating authority, gas water heaters shall be modeled using propane as their fuel

rule-63z32-a.test_description: A one story single zone office building has a service water heating system. The baseline and proposed building's SHW systems have defined service water heating uses with units of power, but has 0 power use defined.

standard.ruleset_reference: Table G3.1 #1, proposed column, (a)
standard.rule_description: All buildings that will have service water heating loads must include those loads in the simulation

rule-63z32-b.test_description: A one story single zone office building has a service water heating system. The baseline and proposed building's SHW systems have defined service water heating uses with units of OTHER.
rule-63z32-b.expected_raised_message_includes: The SWH Building Area type is UNDETERMINED, so this rule cannot assess whether building type is likely to have SWH loads

standard.ruleset_reference: Table G3.1 #1, proposed column, (a)
standard.rule_description: All buildings that will have service water heating loads must include those loads in the simulation

rule-63z32-c.test_description: A one story single zone parking garage use type building has a service water heating system. The baseline and proposed building's SHW systems have defined service water heating uses with units of power.
rule-63z32-c.expected_raised_message_includes: There are no service water heating loads simulated in this building segment

standard.ruleset_reference: Table G3.1 #1, proposed column, (a)
standard.rule_description: All buildings that will have service water heating loads must include those loads in the simulation
